output.summary: The dashboard is self-reported with no objective criteria. Its green share jumped from 64% to 91% after the November 2025 memo and the 2026 bonus tied to percent green. The independent audit, the escalation log and a lead's account all show green projects that were behind schedule, so the dashboard is not accurate and inflation is supported. Platform Engineering is not the primary cause of missed dates. CSD files late and incomplete requests: 58% are returned, and well-specified early requests are delivered 87% of the time. Platform capacity is a real but secondary factor. Whether the SVP knowingly directed green reporting is unestablished. The preferred action is objective status criteria and a customer-register-based bonus metric. Transferring engineers, removing the SVP or unmasking the anonymous survey authors would be harmful.
